title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Appreciate you getting back to me. I was gonna say even if you didn’t, you’re still my guy, but I didn’t wanna give you that option lol
No problem.  You have a job to do I just can’t say to much most times.  Anyway appreciate the text
Actually worked out because my guy said six weeks
And I put 3-4 out there (you) “General timetable for similar injuries according to a sports medical professional”
That’s fair.  Like I said we will just take it as it comes
I’m pulling for him. I like that guy. I got a story for you, hopefully Sunday. Later
